description: This file contains a test case for demonstrating decorators in TypeScript using the Playwright testing framework. It imports testing utilities, defines a test that verifies a class method decorated with a custom decorator logs messages upon invocation.

classes.name: POM
classes.description: A class with a method 'greet' decorated with a custom decorator that logs messages upon method entry and exit.

methods.name: loggedMethod
methods.description: A decorator function that wraps an original method to log messages when the method is entered and exited.
